headline: Quiet day: no big fair, match or arena show
taxi: Normal weekday demand, a bit higher if the evening rain arrives; theatre exits around 23:00.
weather: Cloudy with sunny spells, light rain late evening, 9–12°C

headline: Architect@Work and Forum Retail open at MiCo, Tokio Hotel at Assago
taxi: CityLife at show closing (~19:00); Assago exits around 23:00; rain adds demand.
linate: Some extra business arrivals for the trade shows.

headline: Last day of Architect@Work and Forum Retail in the week's heaviest rain, on the eve of the ATM strike
taxi: High demand in the showers all day; CityLife at closing; busy evening ahead of Friday's strike.
linate: Normal business traffic; allow extra time in the rain.

headline: ATM strike: metro, bus and tram at risk 08:45–15:00 and after 18:00, with rain; Blue at Assago
taxi: Very high all day outside the 15:00–18:00 window; long queues at stations and in the centre; Assago exits around 23:00.
linate: M4 at risk outside guaranteed hours; ISF delegates start arriving; book a taxi early.
weather: Rain in the morning and evening, dry mid-afternoon, 10–14°C

headline: ISF World Congress opens at MiCo and Blue play a second night at Assago
taxi: CityLife at congress close; Assago exits around 23:00; centre on Saturday night.
linate: Busy arrivals of international ISF congress delegates.
weather: Drizzle in the morning, brighter afternoon, 7–12°C

headline: ISF World Congress continues at MiCo; Jungle at Assago
taxi: CityLife at congress close; Assago exits around 23:00.

headline: ISF World Congress at MiCo and Big Buyer opens
taxi: CityLife around congress and fair closing; normal weekday demand elsewhere.
linate: Business arrivals and ISF delegates; steady traffic.

headline: SIMEI opens at Rho as ISF Congress closes at MiCo
taxi: Rho at fair closing (~18:00); CityLife busy with Big Buyer and ISF departures.
linate: ISF delegates leaving and international SIMEI buyers arriving.
